Name: pwsh.exe
CommandLine:
"C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -Command "try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch {}
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$run = '.recursive\run\62-litellm-pi-craft-codex-execution-hardening'
$liveDir = Join-Path $run 'evidence\logs\addendum-11\live\runtime'
$craftDir = Join-Path $run 'evidence\logs\addendum-11\live\craft-runtime'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $liveDir, $craftDir | Out-Null
$craftMatches = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'Craft Agents.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'bun.exe') -and $_.CommandLine -like '*\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum11-headless*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
$craftMatches | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $craftDir 'craft-headless-processes-before-cleanup.json')
foreach ($proc in $craftMatches) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$craftRemaining = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'Craft Agents.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'bun.exe') -and $_.CommandLine -like '*\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum11-headless*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine)
$craftRemaining | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $craftDir 'craft-headless-processes-after-cleanup.json')
$port = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3456 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,State,OwningProcess
$port | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $liveDir 'port-3456.final.json')
$roleModelProcesses = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'role-model-runtime.exe' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*role-model-runtime*' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine
$roleModelProcesses | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $liveDir 'role-model-processes.final.json')
$related = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'role-model|runtime|llama|litellm|python|node|pi|Craft Agents|bun' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'role-model|litellm|llama|pi-role-model|Craft Agents|\.tmp-craft-headless-addendum11' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine
$related | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $liveDir 'related-processes.final.json')
curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:3456/healthz | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $liveDir 'healthz.final.json')
[pscustomobject]@{ stoppedIsolatedCraft=$craftMatches.Count; remainingIsolatedCraft=$craftRemaining.Count; runtimePortOwners=$port; roleModelProcesses=$roleModelProcesses } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8"
